notes: Neo4j 5 Community, single instance (causal clustering, CDC, online backup and read routing are Enterprise-only). Order items are CONTAINS relationships, categories a CHILD_OF tree, so graph_traversal and join_lookup are native. Built-in full-text (Lucene) and HNSW vector indexes; no native TTL or pub/sub.

strategy.tool: neo4j-admin database dump (single-file archive) — Community has no online backup, and STOP DATABASE is rejected, so the server is stopped for the dump
strategy.restore: offline: stop, neo4j-admin database load --overwrite-destination=true, start (both run as the neo4j user in a helper container over the data volume)
strategy.pitr: Enterprise only (transaction-log based); Community = last full dump
strategy.schedule: a maintenance window per dump (cron: stop, dump, start) — or move to Enterprise for online full/differential backups
